title: Import Permit Substitution for IRC
summary: The policy evolved from specific commodity-based import permits to a broader regulatory framework allowing industrial units under BEPZA to substitute the Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate (IRC) with an authority-issued import permit. This ensures that entities under special economic jurisdictions maintain compliance without redundant registration requirements.

evolution.scope: Expanded from specific commodity control to general industrial import compliance.
evolution.legal_basis: Shifted from ad-hoc permit requirements to a standardized exemption mechanism for IRC-exempt industrial units.

timeline.change: Initial requirement for specific commodity import permits for BEPZA-governed entities.
Formalized the substitution of Industrial IRC with authority-issued import permits for entities under BEPZA, BEZA, and others.
Reiteration of the 2024 policy framework for import permit substitution.

member_objects.resolved_text: ৭। বাংলাদেশ রপ্তানি প্রক্রিয়াকরণ অঞ্চল কর্তৃপক্ষ (BEPZA), বাংলাদেশ অর্থনৈতিক অঞ্চল কর্তৃপক্ষ (BEZA), বাংলাদেশ হাইটেক পার্ক কর্তৃপক্ষ অথবা আইন বলে প্রতিষ্ঠিত অন্য যে কোনো কর্তৃপক্ষের নিয়ন্ত্রণাধীন শিল্প প্রতিষ্ঠান যাহাদের জন্য শিল্প ভোক্তা আইআরসি গ্রহণের বাধ্যবাধকতা নাই সেইরূপ ক্ষেত্রে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষ কর্তৃক ইস্যূকৃত আমদানি অনুমতিপত্র দাখিল করিতে হইবে।

Bangladesh Export Processing Zones Autho: Industrial enterprises under the control of this authority that are exempt from the obligation to obtain an Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate must submit an import permit issued by the authority.
Bangladesh Economic Zones Authority: Industrial enterprises under the control of this authority that are exempt from the obligation to obtain an Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate must submit an import permit issued by the authority.
Bangladesh Hi-Tech Park Authority: Industrial enterprises under the control of this authority that are exempt from the obligation to obtain an Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate must submit an import permit issued by the authority.
Industrial Import Registration Certifica: Enterprises exempt from obtaining this registration certificate are required to provide alternative import authorization documents from their respective regulatory authorities.

Bangladesh Export Processing Zones Autho: Industrial enterprises operating under the control of this authority are required to submit an import permit issued by the relevant authority in cases where they are not obligated to obtain an Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate.
Bangladesh Economic Zones Authority: Industrial enterprises operating under the control of this authority must provide an import permit issued by the relevant governing body if they are exempt from the requirement of holding an Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate.
Bangladesh Hi-Tech Park Authority: Industrial units managed by this authority must submit an import permit issued by the respective authority when they do not have a mandatory obligation to obtain an Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate.
Import Permit: This document must be submitted by industrial enterprises operating under specified statutory authorities when those enterprises are exempted from the requirement of holding an Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate.
Industrial Import Registration Certifica: Industrial enterprises under the purview of specific government authorities are permitted to submit import permits in lieu of this registration certificate if they are not otherwise legally obligated to hold it.
